sources.source: Statistics Sweden (SCB), average monthly salary after sector, all sectors, total gender.
sources.unit: SEK/month; annual comparator calculated as monthly × 12
sources.definition: SCB average monthly salary across all sectors, both sexes (total gender), for each year 1992–2025. Salary is not disposable income or actual annual earnings.
sources.transformation: Annual comparator is monthly average multiplied by 12; nominal values. Monthly source values retained in the separate salary file.

sources.source: Swedish mail-order catalogues: Spelhuset/High Score Express 1993 issue 18, and Nordic Games advertisement in Datormagazin 1994 issue 19. Bergsala brochure scans were also reviewed but do not show verifiable prices.
sources.definition: Intended annual measure is the arithmetic mean of documented Swedish new-retail prices for Nintendo games in a dated source sample. Each published year must state the sample size and sampling basis; it must not be presented as a market-wide mean unless the source coverage supports that claim.
sources.coverage: Two sparse SNES catalogue samples: 1993 issue 18 lists 17 SNES games for sale; 1994 issue 19 lists 9 SNES games explicitly under 'SUPER NINTENDO – NYA'. Both are Swedish mail-order seller prices, not a representative all-retailer market sample. 1994 advertises low mail-order prices. No observations are available for other years, and the catalogue series from 1988–1993 does not itself establish prices.
sources.transformation: CSV values are unweighted arithmetic means of the listed game prices (1993: 17 prices, 11,133 SEK total => 654.88 SEK; 1994: 9 prices, 4,941 SEK total => 549.00 SEK). Values describe each dated seller catalogue's selected SNES listings only, not a Swedish annual market average. They are nominal advertised prices incl. VAT; shipping excluded where stated. The 1993 and 1994 seller/sample methods differ, so no year-to-year price or wage-share trend is inferred. No interpolation; absent years remain gaps. Wage shares use SCB average monthly salary × 12 only to contextualize these dated observations.

data.price_basis: Unweighted mean of 17 advertised SNES titles in a Swedish mail-order catalogue; listed selling prices, not a market-wide mean
data.wage_basis: SCB average monthly salary, all sectors, total gender × 12

data.price_basis: Unweighted mean of 9 SNES games explicitly listed as new in a Swedish mail-order advertisement; seller describes its prices as low mail-order prices, not a market-wide mean
data.wage_basis: SCB average monthly salary, all sectors, total gender × 12
